description: Read a published card: its question and answers, threshold, licence, lineage, author-reported agreement numbers, versions and some public cases. `ref` is hub:owner/slug or hub:owner/slug@rv_….

hub.description: Address of the hub to ask. Default: the hub this server was started with (VERDICT_HUB_URL).

ref.description: `hub:owner/slug` for the newest version of a card, or `hub:owner/slug@rv_…` for one version, as `hub_search` returns it.

name: hub_get
title: Read a hub card
